Forward concise posts when they still contain a concrete market, macroeconomic, policy, company, asset-price, or investing thesis. profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: Treat posts promoting the $INSIDER token or Insider Crypto Tracker's own crypto product as advertisements and mark them irrelevant. Exclude token staking, burns, buybacks, tokenomics, flywheel, token utility, token access, and token price or holding calls, even when they mention revenue, percentages, financial terms, or market language. Continue forwarding independent substantive market analysis that only mentions the account or links to its site without promoting $INSIDER or the product.

profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: DokterMarket frequently publishes Indonesian macro updates and IDX stock analysis, but also promotes paid or member-only research. Exclude promotional or sales posts, including Member Only or member-only teasers, premium or subscriber content, paid research, subscription or access invitations, signal-service marketing, and clickbait profit promises. For a direct IDX ticker, use id_stocks_swing only when the central thesis is technical charting or a trade setup, such as wave counts, support or resistance, breakouts, indicators, entry, target, or stop-loss; otherwise use id_stocks_news. Do not reject ordinary market news or substantive analysis merely because it links to doktermarket.com.

profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: Forward substantive IDX analysis. Use id_stocks_swing only for a direct IDX ticker's technical chart or trade setup, including wave counts, chart patterns, support or resistance, breakout or breakdown, indicators, entry, target, stop-loss, or risk/reward. Use id_stocks_news for dividend schedules, earnings, corporate actions, issuer news, fundamentals, or valuation. Use macro_news for broad IHSG, market-wide, or foreign-flow posts. Do not route to swing merely because a post contains numbers, tickers, or a target price. Exclude casual reactions, greetings, memes, generic engagement, unsupported hype, clickbait profit promises, and paid research or trading-service promotions.

profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: Forward substantive stock, market, and Elliott Wave analysis. For IDX posts, use id_stocks_swing when the central thesis is technical price action or a trade setup, including wave counts, chart patterns, support or resistance, breakout or breakdown, indicators, entry, target, stop-loss, risk/reward, or a defined price path. Use id_stocks_news for IDX news, fundamentals, valuation, earnings, or corporate actions. A valuation-based target is not swing, and numbers, tickers, or an image alone are not evidence of a technical setup. US-listed posts use us_stocks_news, the US stocks news route. Exclude greetings, generic engagement, trading-group performance marketing, paid courses, paid research, signal-service promotions, and clickbait profit promises.

Direct IDX-listed company or ticker thesis.

profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: Forward substantive Indonesian macro, market, and IDX-listed company analysis. Keep broad IHSG, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, global-risk, and market-wide views in macro_news; keep direct IDX company, earnings, corporate-action, and valuation theses in id_stocks_news. Exclude generic biographies or praise of an investor or other person, standalone track records, annual-return statistics, and performance-history posts without a concrete macro, market, policy, or company thesis. Also exclude reposts, casual reactions, greetings, memes, generic engagement, unsupported hype, clickbait profit promises, and paid research or trading-service promotions.

profiles.additional_prompt_instruction: Forward substantive analysis across the configured financial-market scope, including commodities. Route direct US-listed company theses to us_stocks_news and other substantive theses to macro_news. Exclude distribution notices whose main purpose is announcing, linking to, or soliciting signups for The Kobeissi Letter, weekly-letter, newsletter, reports, research products, or Chart of the Week. This includes published, view/read-through-link, sign-up, FREE, free, paid, and member-only access notices. Only forward posts whose supplied text contains a substantive market fact, analysis, forecast, or argument. Exclude generic trading or investing education and unrelated political or social commentary. A link, account identity, date, chart label, or BREAKING alone is not substantive.
